feature_contract.goal: Keep the original OutRun 2006 D3D9 projection, vertex stream and index bindings intact across R84 two-eye fixed-function and XYZRHW GPU draws, reporting restore failures rather than erroneously returning native Draw success.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Exact R84 native GPU binding restore across FVF142 HUD/rank/ESC and shadow VB/IB XYZRHW paths only. Preserve original left draw identity, prevent a new fallback draw, protect SkyGlow, original input/FFB, R26_SAFE rollback, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Confirmed source-level error contract: existing R30 GPU submission returned its prior successful HRESULT after SetTransform(PROJECTION), SetStreamSource, or SetIndices restoration failed while only arming mono safety; this could report success despite mutated game render state. No physical failure frame asserted.
trace_stages: Original game ScreenHud, projected rank and XYZ vertices enter R84 R30 FVF142 and converted VB/IB drawing routes.
R30 issues native left and private right GPU draw then restores original D3D9 projection, VB stream and optional index buffers.
Failed original state restoration must mark right-eye frame unsafe, invalidate affected depth and expose failed HRESULT while R29 Present/host avoids partially restored stereo state.
subcomponents: Fixed-function native HUD/rank/ESC optical PROJECTION restore failure propagates a failed result and does not masquerade as complete.
Dynamic or shadow VB stream restores track HRESULT, flag incomplete right-eye state and return failure only after original drawing is attempted.
Indexed VB/IB restoration attempts both original setters independently, retaining original failed GPU HRESULT and failing closed on either restoration failure.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 fixed-function HUD plus transformed VB/IB stereo draw and game state
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Successful original GPU draw is never reported successful if original projection, vertex stream or indices cannot be restored; stereo frame safety is armed.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Failed original GPU draw, one failed original setter, multiple failures and unmodified D3D9 fallback
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Negative restore tests retain original native GPU failure when present and do not reissue physical left Draw, overwrite input/FFB, reclassify SkyGlow or modify R26_SAFE.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Windows R84 x86 game, x64 host, package and cross-domain inspections
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: One validation-bearing exact SHA passes DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact; actual Quest3 remains separately UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Authenticated R84 source 664b69f contains three restore blocks which detect failed original D3D9 state setters but return previous GPU draw result unconditionally.
diagnosis.root_cause: HRESULT from the last native GPU Draw is returned regardless of SetTransform projection, SetStreamSource or SetIndices restoration failure. Mono-safety side effects do not repair the original game state or change the reported success status.
source_trace: R84 native FVF142 ScreenHud/ProjectedWorldMarker2D/ESC enters R30TryFixedFunctionOriginalSpriteStereo and retains original PROJECTION.
R30TryXyzrhwPrimitiveVB and R30TryXyzrhwIndexedPrimitiveVB submit original-left/secondary-right GPU geometry.
After native GPU submission original D3D9 PROJECTION/stream/indices restore setters run; failure now marks right eye invalid and propagates a failed result.
alternatives_rejected: A generic extra native left draw or automatic E_NOTIMPL retry is unsafe after a physical GPU submission and could duplicate alpha; original input, world and SkyGlow owners remain untouched.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Right-eye frame validity is explicitly marked failed when original restore setters fail; the source does not establish a real Quest3 failure or prove current binocular correctness.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Fixed-function projection plus VB and VB/IB state restore now fail closed and retain original HRESULT errors; shared header static_assert covers success, draw failure, restore failure and nonzero success status.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: R30StateRestore constexpr compile contract cases and portable g++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror smoke pass; full exact-SHA Windows jobs pending.

failure_repair.root_cause: Policy verifier blocked first material SHA because mandatory same-TASK_ID feature_contract run record was absent; Windows game/host/package jobs were skipped, not a source compile failure.
